0022600135.text: The 76ers (3-1, 2-1 at home, 1-0 on the road) sit 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, with a 3-1 record over their last ten games but a current one-game losing streak. The Pacers (2-2, 0-1 at home, 2-1 on the road) are 8th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), all listed as out. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle, sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring, strain), Andrew Nembhard (neck, soreness), Obi Toppin (hand, sprain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring, soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 105-94 regular-season win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026.
